scope.completion_definition: reviewed terminal disposition under evidence currently in custody

tracks.reopen_when: enactment, appropriation, or implementation evidence changes the H.R. 2247 cost-note basis
proposal-specific CY2026 imaging access, beneficiary, rural, quality, behavior, and overlap evidence closes all six blocked gates
a current-law Pell score and complete access, completion, distribution, and borrowing-substitution floors are available
proposal-specific trust-fund, cohort, adequacy, employer, administration, overlap, and long-range results are available
a current-law school-meal score and complete hardship, participation, burden, take-up, and distribution floors are available
enactment or a replacement candidate supplies a current net-cost path with claims, cohort, implementation, pension, and Medicaid effects
a current-law crop-insurance score closes producer, access, coverage, disaster-substitution, food-security, and resilience floors
a current FYDP mapping closes readiness, transition, program-schedule, allied-posture, allocation, and rescore gates
a current NFIP score closes affordability, take-up, mapping-equity, aid-interaction, exposure, and mitigation-response floors
a program-level DOJ allocation closes victimization, civil-rights, victim-service, juvenile, local-fiscal, and geographic floors
a program-level allocation closes energy-burden, delivery, emissions, resilience, innovation, state-local, income, and geographic effects
program and regional allocations close diplomacy, health, humanitarian, security-assistance, geographic, and national-security effects
an owner-attributed scored control effect closes gross-to-net, returns, appeals, burden, implementation, and distribution evidence
the frozen fiscal target, admitted upstream effects, model inputs, or policy objective materially changes
a nonzero admitted upstream annual debt path requires endogenous interest recomputation

public_warning: Taxlane has finished its current internal analysis of all fifteen tracks. Completion means every track has a reviewed terminal disposition under current evidence; it does not mean every candidate was admitted, enacted, implemented, or officially scored. Nine primary spending tracks close at reviewed zero admission, PAY remains non-additive, OAS remains separate, NET remains endogenous, TRN retains a conditional cost note, and REV retains an internal planning rate card.
